title: A Stretchable Nanowire UV-Vis-NIR Photodetector with High Performance

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: UV-to-NIR nanowire photodetectors reported so far combine low ON/OFF ratios with slow (>10 s) UV response. PbS QDs blended into P3HT nanowires should sensitise the NIR and, via charge transfer, raise ON/OFF and speed.
states.detail: Absorbed: n1 (HYP/need), n2 (HYP/hypothesis), n3 (DES/modification), n4 (DES/architecture), n5 (PRC/synthesis), n6 (PRC/forming)

states.title: Structure state
states.head: PbS QDs are dispersed uniformly through the single hybrid NW without large clusters. Each hybrid NW forms a freestanding arch lifted off the substrate between its two contacts

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Photoinduced charge transfer between PbS QDs and P3HT, dominated by hole transfer QD to P3HT, extracts photocarriers. Hybrid NW photoresponse extends into the NIR (850-940 nm) because PbS QDs absorb there.
states.detail: Absorbed: n9 (MEC/pathway), n10 (PRP/value), n12 (MEC/pathway). Premises: Fluorescent exciton fraction is ~20% in PbS QDs but ~1% in P3HT, so PL quenching mainly probes QD-side transfer; Approximate band alignment: HOMO offset for hole transfer QD to P3HT becomes unfavourable as QD size grows; Arched or buckled interconnect architectures relax external strain in stretchable electronics

states.title: Performance state
states.head: Single hybrid NW photodetector switches cleanly from 365 to 850 nm with ON/OFF up to ~600 and sub-second rise/fall. Array photoresponse, ON/OFF and rise/fall times stay essentially unchanged up to 100% stretching and over 100 cycles

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Direct-written PbS QD-P3HT NW arches give a broadband UV-vis-NIR photodetector that keeps its performance under 100% stretching
